name: Weed Snobs Diamond Infused Preroll | Blueberry Cheesecake
description: Blueberry Cheesecake is a indica dominate strain that is a rather popular cross of Big Buddha Cheese and the eminent Blueberry. This strain produces mostly calming but euphoric, happy and creative effects.
